verses.du-a-u-l-wazifati-c1-v1: yā rabbi lā tushmit bnā l-ʾaʿdāʾa walā tukhayyiban lanā r-rajāʾa
verses.du-a-u-l-wazifati-c1-v2: faʾaghninā min jūdika l-fayyāḍi wāshfi qulūbanā mina l-ʾamrāḍi
verses.du-a-u-l-wazifati-c1-v3: bin-nūri fāmlaʾahā wabīlʾīmāni wal-ʿilmi wal-ʾasrāri wal-ʿirfāni
verses.du-a-u-l-wazifati-c1-v4: man kādanā fakādihi rabba l-warā waman yurīdu makranā fadammirā
verses.du-a-u-l-wazifati-c1-v5: man ʿādanā faʿādihi waman ʾarā danā bisūʾi rabbanā lā tanṣurā
verses.du-a-u-l-wazifati-c1-v6: waman ʿalaynā qad baghā fāhlikhu wafī salāsili l-ʾadhā fāslukhu
verses.du-a-u-l-wazifati-c1-v7: wājʿal liman fī mawtihi bishārah lil-muslimīna s-sūʾa wal-khasārah
verses.du-a-u-l-wazifati-c1-v8: wānṣur likulli man lanā fī naṣrihi naṣrā wabārikan lahu fī ʿumrihi
verses.du-a-u-l-wazifati-c1-v9: yā man yujību daʿwata d-dāʿī ʾidhā daʿā wayakshifu l-kurūba wal-ʾadhā
verses.du-a-u-l-wazifati-c1-v10: ʾajib liʿabdika ḍ-ḍaʿīfi l-wajili wāghfir dhunūbahu l-kathīra yā walī
verses.du-a-u-l-wazifati-c1-v11: bijāhi sayyidi l-warā l-māḥī l-karīm ṣallā ʿalayhi rabbunā l-barru r-raḥīm
